answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ridge of a task receipt, and the atlas is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
